## 验证 / Validation

<!-- 写明实际执行的命令和结果、未验证项；视觉修改附截图。
List commands actually run, results, and gaps; attach screenshots for visual changes. -->

## 提交前核对 / Checklist

- [ ] 改动范围清晰，相关检查通过。 / The scope is clear and relevant checks passed.
- [ ] 协议、数据、命令、资产变化和中英文文档已按需同步。 / Protocol, data, commands, assets, and bilingual docs were updated where needed.
- [ ] 未包含凭据、私人对话、会话数据或构建输出。 / No credentials, private conversations, session data, or build output are included.
- [ ] 如属发版，中英更新日志含当前版本、同一日期、实际变化和验证边界，Release 采用相同内容。 / For releases, both changelogs include the current version, matching date, actual changes, and verification limits; Release notes reuse them.
